scientific_integrity: Proved structural reconstruction and exact edge accounting, and replayed integer census with independently constructed full graphs for the overlapping small orders. No independent scientific assessment or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The polynomial bound has exponent depending on fixed walk length k and assumes \(n\ge 2k\); the supplied code certifies the \(k=3\) census only for \(6\le n\le24\), not an all-n closed count. The result does not count primitive cycles for general composite k.
title: Boundary-rank enumeration of short cycles in permutation-overlap graphs
